questions.name: #1 Botswana
questions.en:
Although Botswana is rich in diamonds, it has high unemployment and stratified socioeconomic classes.
In 1999, the nation ______ its first budget deficit in 16 years ______ of a slump in the international diamond market.
Yet Botswana ______ one of the wealthiest and most stable countries on the African ______ .
suffered , endure , while , continent , remains , enjoyed , because
questions.full:
Although Botswana is rich in diamonds, it has high unemployment and stratified socioeconomic classes.
In 1999, the nation ______ its first budget deficit in 16 years ______ of a slump in the international diamond market.
Yet Botswana ______ one of the wealthiest and most stable countries on the African ______ .

suffered , endure , while , continent , remains , enjoyed , because

答案:

2. because
3. remains
4. continent

sense_groups.chinese: 但它失业率高，社会经济阶层分化严重。

sense_groups.chinese: 1999年，该国遭遇了16年来的首次预算赤字，

sense_groups.chinese: 原因是国际钻石市场低迷。

sense_groups.english: Yet Botswana remains one of the wealthiest and most stable countries on the African continent.
sense_groups.chinese: 然而，博茨瓦纳仍然是非洲大陆最富裕、最稳定的国家之一。

questions.name: #2 Open Door Policy
questions.en:

Although the Open Door is generally ______ with China, it also received recognition at the Berlin Conference of 1885, which declared that no power could ______ preferential duties in the Congo basin.
declaration , blatant , rooted , associated , disturb , specific , levy

questions.name: #4 Dark Matter
questions.en:
A new interdisciplinary centre for the study of the frontiers of the universe, from the tiniest subatomic particle to the largest chain of galaxies, has been formed at the University of Texas at Austin.
The Texas Cosmology Center will be a way for the university's departments of Astronomy and Physics to ______ on research that concerns them both.
"This centre will bring the two departments together in an area where they overlap in the physics of the very early universe," said Dr. Neal Evans, Astronomy Department chair.
Astronomical observations have revealed the presence of dark matter and dark energy, ______ that challenge our knowledge of fundamental physics.
And today's leading theories in physics ______ energies so high that no earthbound particle accelerator can test them.
They need the universe as their ______ .
Dr. Steven Weinberg, Nobel laureate and professor of physics at the university, called the advent of the centre "a very exciting development" for that department.
laboratory , discoveries , collaborate , destination , overlap , polish , vicious , involve

答案:

2. discoveries
3. involve
4. laboratory

sense_groups.english: A new interdisciplinary centre for the study of the frontiers of the universe, from the tiniest subatomic particle to the largest chain of galaxies, has been formed at the University of Texas at Austin.
sense_groups.chinese: 一个研究宇宙前沿的新跨学科中心，从最小的亚原子粒子到最大的星系链，已在德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校成立。

sense_groups.english: The Texas Cosmology Center will be a way for the university's departments of Astronomy and Physics to collaborate on research that concerns them both.
sense_groups.chinese: 德克萨斯宇宙学中心将成为该校天文学系和物理学系在共同关心的研究上进行合作的一种方式。

sense_groups.english: "This centre will bring the two departments together in an area where they overlap in the physics of the very early universe," said Dr. Neal Evans, Astronomy Department chair.

sense_groups.chinese: 天文观测揭示了暗物质和暗能量的存在，这些发现挑战了我们对基础物理学的认识。

sense_groups.chinese: 而当今物理学的主要理论涉及的能量如此之高，以至于地球上没有任何粒子加速器能够测试它们。

sense_groups.english: They need the universe as their laboratory.
sense_groups.chinese: 它们需要宇宙作为它们的实验室。

sense_groups.english: Dr. Steven Weinberg, Nobel laureate and professor of physics at the university, called the advent of the centre "a very exciting development" for that department.
sense_groups.chinese: 诺贝尔奖得主、该校物理学教授史蒂文·温伯格博士称该中心的成立对该系来说是“一个非常令人兴奋的发展”。

questions.name: #5 Thea Proctor
questions.en:
Thea Proctor was just sixteen when her entry at the Bowral Art Competition caught the eye of the judge, Arthur Streeton.
It was the first of many associations with art world ______ .
The next year saw her at the Julian Ashton Art School in the illustrious company of Elioth Gruner, Sydney Long and George Lambert, for whom she often posed and who ______ her great friend until his death in 1930.
Lambert's paintings and sketches of Proctor emphasize the elegance of her dress.
A keen interest in fashion was just one ______ of her fascination with design, and she saw herself as an early style guru on a quest to rid Australian art of "its lack of imagination and inventive design".
Skilled in watercolor and drawing, Proctor did not ______ herself to paper, canvases or to her popular magazine illustrations; she designed theater sets and a restaurant interior and wrote on a range of subjects from flower arranging to the colors of cars.
It made for a busy and ______ life but, as she said, she was not the sort of person "who could sit at home and knit socks."
shrink , remained , varied , aspect , limit , experiment , recruits , posture

sense_groups.english: Thea Proctor was just sixteen

sense_groups.chinese: 她视自己为早期的时尚大师

sense_groups.chinese: 她设计了戏剧布景和餐厅内部装饰

sense_groups.english: and wrote on a range of subjects

questions.name: #6 Per Capita Income
questions.en:
To understand how many inhabitants of a country are poor, it is not enough to know a country's per capita ______ .
The number of poor people in a country and the ______ quality of life depend on how equally or unequally income is ______ across the population.
In Brazil and Hungary, for ______ ,per capita income levels are quite comparable, but the ______ of poverty in Brazil is much higher.
example , distributed , incidence , average , effects , expenditure , income , lessened
questions.full:
To understand how many inhabitants of a country are poor, it is not enough to know a country's per capita ______ .
The number of poor people in a country and the ______ quality of life depend on how equally or unequally income is ______ across the population.
In Brazil and Hungary, for ______ ,per capita income levels are quite comparable, but the ______ of poverty in Brazil is much higher.

example , distributed , incidence , average , effects , expenditure , income , lessened

答案:
1. income
2. average
3. distributed
4. example
5. incidence

sense_groups.english: To understand how many inhabitants of a country are poor,
sense_groups.chinese: 要了解一个国家有多少居民是贫困的，

sense_groups.english: it is not enough to know a country's per capita income.
sense_groups.chinese: 仅知道一个国家的人均收入是不够的。

sense_groups.english: The number of poor people in a country and the average quality of life
sense_groups.chinese: 一个国家的贫困人口数量和平均生活质量

sense_groups.english: depend on how equally or unequally income is distributed across the population.
sense_groups.chinese: 取决于收入在人口中分配得多么平等或不平等。

sense_groups.english: In Brazil and Hungary, for example,
sense_groups.chinese: 例如，在巴西和匈牙利，

sense_groups.english: per capita income levels are quite comparable,
sense_groups.chinese: 人均收入水平相当可比，

sense_groups.english: but the incidence of poverty in Brazil is much higher.
sense_groups.chinese: 但巴西的贫困发生率要高得多。

Nearly as ______ as the competitions were the historic sites used for the games.

questions.full:

2. hormones
3. response
4. finish
5. immune
6. disease

sense_groups.english: Stress is what you feel when you have to handle more than you are used to.
sense_groups.chinese: 压力是当你需要处理超出你习惯的事情时所感受到的。

sense_groups.english: When you are stressed, your body responds as though you are in danger.
sense_groups.chinese: 当你感到压力时，你的身体会做出反应，好像你处于危险之中。

sense_groups.english: It makes hormones that speed up your heart, make you breathe faster, and give you a burst of energy.
sense_groups.chinese: 它会释放激素，加速你的心跳，让你呼吸加快，并给你一股能量。

sense_groups.english: This is called the fight-or-flight stress response.
sense_groups.chinese: 这被称为战斗或逃跑的压力反应。

sense_groups.english: Some stress is normal and even useful.
sense_groups.chinese: 有些压力是正常的，甚至是有用的。

sense_groups.english: Stress can help if you need to work hard or react quickly.
sense_groups.chinese: 如果你需要努力工作或快速反应，压力可以帮助你。

sense_groups.english: For example, it can help you win a race or finish an important job on time.
sense_groups.chinese: 例如，它可以帮助你赢得比赛或按时完成重要工作。

sense_groups.english: But if stress happens too often or lasts too long, it can have bad effects.
sense_groups.chinese: 但如果压力发生得太频繁或持续时间太长，它可能会产生不良影响。

sense_groups.english: It can be linked to headaches, an upset stomach, back pain, and trouble sleeping.
sense_groups.chinese: 它可能与头痛、胃部不适、背痛和睡眠问题有关。

sense_groups.english: It can weaken your immune system, making it harder to fight off disease.
sense_groups.chinese: 它会削弱你的免疫系统，使你更难抵抗疾病。

questions.name: #109 Bizarre Universe
questions.en:
It seems we live in a bizarre Universe.
One of the greatest mysteries in the whole of science is the prospect that 75% of the Universe is made up from a mysterious ______ known as 'Dark Energy', which causes an acceleration of the cosmic expansion.
Since a further 21% of the Universe is made up from invisible 'Cold Dark Matter' that can only be ______ through its gravitational effects, the ordinary atomic matter making up the rest is apparently only 4% of the total cosmic budget.
These ______ require a shift in our perception as great as that made after Copernicus' ______ that the Earth moves around the Sun.
This lecture will start by reviewing the chequered history of Dark Energy, not only since Einstein's proposal for a similar entity in 1917, but by tracing the concept back to Newton's ideas.
This lecture will ______ the current evidence for Dark Energy and future surveys in which UCL is heavily involved: the "Dark Energy Survey", the Hubble Space Telescope and the proposed Euclid space mission.
molecule , detected , revelation , theories , substance , summarise , discoveries , focus
questions.full:
It seems we live in a bizarre Universe.
One of the greatest mysteries in the whole of science is the prospect that 75% of the Universe is made up from a mysterious ______ known as 'Dark Energy', which causes an acceleration of the cosmic expansion.
Since a further 21% of the Universe is made up from invisible 'Cold Dark Matter' that can only be ______ through its gravitational effects, the ordinary atomic matter making up the rest is apparently only 4% of the total cosmic budget.
These ______ require a shift in our perception as great as that made after Copernicus' ______ that the Earth moves around the Sun.
This lecture will start by reviewing the chequered history of Dark Energy, not only since Einstein's proposal for a similar entity in 1917, but by tracing the concept back to Newton's ideas.
This lecture will ______ the current evidence for Dark Energy and future surveys in which UCL is heavily involved: the "Dark Energy Survey", the Hubble Space Telescope and the proposed Euclid space mission.

molecule , detected , revelation , theories , substance , summarise , discoveries , focus

答案:
1. substance
2. detected
3. discoveries
4. revelation
5. summarise

sense_groups.english: It seems we live in a bizarre Universe.
sense_groups.chinese: 我们似乎生活在一个奇异的宇宙中。

sense_groups.english: One of the greatest mysteries in the whole of science
sense_groups.chinese: 整个科学界最大的谜团之一

sense_groups.english: is the prospect that 75% of the Universe is made up from a mysterious substance known as 'Dark Energy',
sense_groups.chinese: 是宇宙的75%由一种被称为‘暗能量’的神秘物质构成的可能性，

sense_groups.english: which causes an acceleration of the cosmic expansion.
sense_groups.chinese: 它导致了宇宙膨胀的加速。

sense_groups.english: Since a further 21% of the Universe is made up from invisible 'Cold Dark Matter'
sense_groups.chinese: 由于宇宙中另外21%由不可见的‘冷暗物质’组成，

sense_groups.english: that can only be detected through its gravitational effects,
sense_groups.chinese: 只能通过其引力效应被探测到，

sense_groups.english: the ordinary atomic matter making up the rest is apparently only 4% of the total cosmic budget.
sense_groups.chinese: 构成其余部分的普通原子物质显然只占宇宙总预算的4%。

sense_groups.english: These discoveries require a shift in our perception
sense_groups.chinese: 这些发现要求我们的认知发生转变，

sense_groups.english: as great as that made after Copernicus' revelation that the Earth moves around the Sun.
sense_groups.chinese: 其程度堪比哥白尼揭示地球绕太阳运行后所带来的转变。

sense_groups.english: This lecture will start by reviewing the chequered history of Dark Energy,
sense_groups.chinese: 本次讲座将首先回顾暗能量曲折的历史，

sense_groups.english: not only since Einstein's proposal for a similar entity in 1917,
sense_groups.chinese: 不仅从爱因斯坦在1917年提出类似实体开始，

sense_groups.english: but by tracing the concept back to Newton's ideas.
sense_groups.chinese: 而且将这一概念追溯到牛顿的思想。

sense_groups.english: This lecture will summarise the current evidence for Dark Energy
sense_groups.chinese: 本次讲座将总结当前支持暗能量的证据，

sense_groups.english: and future surveys in which UCL is heavily involved:
sense_groups.chinese: 以及伦敦大学学院深度参与的未来巡天项目：

sense_groups.english: the 'Dark Energy Survey', the Hubble Space Telescope and the proposed Euclid space mission.
sense_groups.chinese: ‘暗能量巡天’、哈勃太空望远镜以及拟议中的欧几里得空间任务。

questions.name: #110 Science Warn Global Warming
questions.en:
You may well ask why science did not warn us of global warming sooner; I think that there are several reasons.
We were from the 1970s until the end of the century ______ ______ the important global problem of stratospheric ______ depletion, which we knew was manageable.
We threw all our efforts into it and succeeded but had little time to spend on climate change.
Climate science was also neglected because twentieth-century science failed to ______ the true nature of Earth as a ______ self-regulating entity.
Biologists were so carried away by Darwin's great vision that they failed to see that living things were tightly coupled to their material environment and that evolution concerns the whole Earth system with living organisms an ______ part of it.
Earth is not the Goldilocks planet of the solar system sitting at the right place for life.
It was in this favourable state some two billion years ago but now our planet has to work hard, against ever increasing heat from the Sun, to keep itself ______ .
We have chosen the worst of times to add to its difficulties.
focusing on , ozone , integral , responsive , recognize , aloof , distracted by , habitable , decide
questions.answer:
1. distracted
2. by
3. ozone
4. recognize
5. responsive
6. integral
7. habitable
questions.full:
You may well ask why science did not warn us of global warming sooner; I think that there are several reasons.
We were from the 1970s until the end of the century ______ ______ the important global problem of stratospheric ______ depletion, which we knew was manageable.
We threw all our efforts into it and succeeded but had little time to spend on climate change.
Climate science was also neglected because twentieth-century science failed to ______ the true nature of Earth as a ______ self-regulating entity.
Biologists were so carried away by Darwin's great vision that they failed to see that living things were tightly coupled to their material environment and that evolution concerns the whole Earth system with living organisms an ______ part of it.
Earth is not the Goldilocks planet of the solar system sitting at the right place for life.
It was in this favourable state some two billion years ago but now our planet has to work hard, against ever increasing heat from the Sun, to keep itself ______ .
We have chosen the worst of times to add to its difficulties.

focusing on , ozone , integral , responsive , recognize , aloof , distracted by , habitable , decide

答案:
1. distracted
2. by
3. ozone
4. recognize
5. responsive
6. integral
7. habitable

sense_groups.english: You may well ask why science did not warn us of global warming sooner;
sense_groups.chinese: 你可能会问，为什么科学没有更早地警告我们全球变暖；

sense_groups.english: I think that there are several reasons.
sense_groups.chinese: 我认为有几个原因。

sense_groups.english: We were from the 1970s until the end of the century distracted by the important global problem of stratospheric ozone depletion,
sense_groups.chinese: 从20世纪70年代到世纪末，我们一直被平流层臭氧消耗这一重要的全球问题分散了注意力，

sense_groups.english: which we knew was manageable.
sense_groups.chinese: 我们知道这是可以解决的。

sense_groups.english: We threw all our efforts into it and succeeded but had little time to spend on climate change.
sense_groups.chinese: 我们全力以赴并取得了成功，但几乎没有时间花在气候变化上。

sense_groups.english: Climate science was also neglected because twentieth-century science failed to recognize the true nature of Earth as a responsive self-regulating entity.
sense_groups.chinese: 气候科学也被忽视了，因为20世纪的科学未能认识到地球作为一个反应灵敏的自我调节实体的真实本质。

sense_groups.english: Biologists were so carried away by Darwin's great vision that they failed to see that living things were tightly coupled to their material environment and that evolution concerns the whole Earth system with living organisms an integral part of it.
sense_groups.chinese: 生物学家们被达尔文的伟大愿景冲昏了头脑，以至于他们没有看到生物与其物质环境紧密相连，进化涉及整个地球系统，而生物是其不可分割的一部分。

sense_groups.english: Earth is not the Goldilocks planet of the solar system sitting at the right place for life.
sense_groups.chinese: 地球并不是太阳系中恰好处于适合生命位置的“金发姑娘”行星。

sense_groups.english: It was in this favourable state some two billion years ago but now our planet has to work hard, against ever increasing heat from the Sun, to keep itself habitable.
sense_groups.chinese: 大约20亿年前，它处于这种有利状态，但现在我们的星球必须努力对抗来自太阳不断增加的热量，以保持自身适宜居住。

sense_groups.english: We have chosen the worst of times to add to its difficulties.
sense_groups.chinese: 我们选择了最糟糕的时期来增加它的困难。

questions.name: #111 Fiction and Life
questions.en:
The precise relationship between fiction and life has been debated extensively.
Most modern critics agree that, whatever its apparent factual content or verisimilitude, fiction is finally to be regarded as a structured Imitation of life and should not be confused with a literal transcription of life itself.
While fiction is a work of the imagination rather than ______ , it can also be based closely on real events, sometimes experienced by the author.
In a work of fiction, the author is not the same ______ the narrator, the voice that tells the story.
Authors maintain a distance from their characters.
Sometimes that distance is obvious for instance, if a male writer tells a story from the point of view of a female character.
Other times it is not so obvious, especially if we know something of the author's life and there are clear connections between the story and the author's life.
The writer of fiction is free to choose his or her subject matter and is free to invent, select, and ______ fictional elements to ______ his or her purpose.
The elements of fiction are the different components that make up a work of fiction.
All literature explores a theme or significant truth expressed in various elements such as character, plot, setting, point of view, style, and tone that are essential and specific to each work of fiction.
All of these elements bind a literary work into a consistent whole and give it unity.
Understanding these elements can help.
move , reality , arrange , for , transcription , achieve , rationality , as , complete
questions.full:
The precise relationship between fiction and life has been debated extensively.
Most modern critics agree that, whatever its apparent factual content or verisimilitude, fiction is finally to be regarded as a structured Imitation of life and should not be confused with a literal transcription of life itself.
While fiction is a work of the imagination rather than ______ , it can also be based closely on real events, sometimes experienced by the author.
In a work of fiction, the author is not the same ______ the narrator, the voice that tells the story.
Authors maintain a distance from their characters.
Sometimes that distance is obvious for instance, if a male writer tells a story from the point of view of a female character.
Other times it is not so obvious, especially if we know something of the author's life and there are clear connections between the story and the author's life.
The writer of fiction is free to choose his or her subject matter and is free to invent, select, and ______ fictional elements to ______ his or her purpose.
The elements of fiction are the different components that make up a work of fiction.
All literature explores a theme or significant truth expressed in various elements such as character, plot, setting, point of view, style, and tone that are essential and specific to each work of fiction.
All of these elements bind a literary work into a consistent whole and give it unity.
Understanding these elements can help.

move , reality , arrange , for , transcription , achieve , rationality , as , complete

答案:
1. reality
2. as
3. arrange
4. achieve

sense_groups.english: The precise relationship between fiction and life has been debated extensively.
sense_groups.chinese: 小说与生活之间的确切关系一直备受争议。

sense_groups.english: Most modern critics agree that, whatever its apparent factual content or verisimilitude, fiction is finally to be regarded as a structured Imitation of life and should not be confused with a literal transcription of life itself.
sense_groups.chinese: 大多数现代评论家认为，无论小说表面上看起来多么真实或逼真，它最终都应被视为一种结构化的生活模仿，不应与生活的字面记录混为一谈。

sense_groups.english: While fiction is a work of the imagination rather than reality, it can also be based closely on real events, sometimes experienced by the author.
sense_groups.chinese: 虽然小说是想象力的产物而非现实，但它也可以紧密基于真实事件，有时是作者亲身经历的。

sense_groups.english: In a work of fiction, the author is not the same as the narrator, the voice that tells the story.
sense_groups.chinese: 在小说作品中，作者与叙述者（即讲故事的声音）并非同一人。

sense_groups.english: Authors maintain a distance from their characters.
sense_groups.chinese: 作者与他们的角色保持距离。

sense_groups.english: Sometimes that distance is obvious for instance, if a male writer tells a story from the point of view of a female character.
sense_groups.chinese: 有时这种距离很明显，例如，如果一位男性作家从女性角色的视角讲述故事。

sense_groups.english: Other times it is not so obvious, especially if we know something of the author's life and there are clear connections between the story and the author's life.
sense_groups.chinese: 其他时候则不那么明显，尤其是当我们对作者的生活有所了解，并且故事与作者的生活有明显联系时。

sense_groups.english: The writer of fiction is free to choose his or her subject matter and is free to invent, select, and arrange fictional elements to achieve his or her purpose.
sense_groups.chinese: 小说作家可以自由选择主题，并自由地虚构、选择和安排小说元素以实现其目的。

sense_groups.english: The elements of fiction are the different components that make up a work of fiction.
sense_groups.chinese: 小说的元素是构成小说作品的不同组成部分。

sense_groups.english: All literature explores a theme or significant truth expressed in various elements such as character, plot, setting, point of view, style, and tone that are essential and specific to each work of fiction.
sense_groups.chinese: 所有文学都探索一个主题或重要真理，这些真理通过人物、情节、背景、视角、风格和语调等各种元素表达，这些元素对每部小说作品都是必不可少且独特的。

sense_groups.english: All of these elements bind a literary work into a consistent whole and give it unity.
sense_groups.chinese: 所有这些元素将文学作品结合成一个连贯的整体，并赋予其统一性。

sense_groups.english: Understanding these elements can help.
sense_groups.chinese: 理解这些元素会有所帮助。

questions.name: #112 Steven Pinker
questions.en:
Steven Pinker, a cognitive psychologist best known for his book "The Language Instinct", has called music "auditory cheesecake, an exquisite confection crafted to tickle the sensitive spots of at least six of our mental faculties." If it ______ from our species, he said, "the rest of our lifestyle would be ______ unchanged." Others have argued that, on the ______ , music, along with art and literature, is part of what makes people human; its absence would have a brutalising effect.
Philip Ball, a British science writer and an ______ music enthusiast, comes down somewhere in the middle.
He says that music is ______ in our auditory, cognitive and motor functions.
We have a music ______ as much as a language instinct, and could not rid ourselves of it if we tried.
sense , virtually , vanished , contrast , remained , avid , avoidable , ingrained , instinct , contrary
questions.answer:
1. vanished
2. virtually
3. contrary
4. avid
5. ingrained
6. instinct
questions.full:
Steven Pinker, a cognitive psychologist best known for his book "The Language Instinct", has called music "auditory cheesecake, an exquisite confection crafted to tickle the sensitive spots of at least six of our mental faculties." If it ______ from our species, he said, "the rest of our lifestyle would be ______ unchanged." Others have argued that, on the ______ , music, along with art and literature, is part of what makes people human; its absence would have a brutalising effect.
Philip Ball, a British science writer and an ______ music enthusiast, comes down somewhere in the middle.
He says that music is ______ in our auditory, cognitive and motor functions.
We have a music ______ as much as a language instinct, and could not rid ourselves of it if we tried.

sense , virtually , vanished , contrast , remained , avid , avoidable , ingrained , instinct , contrary

答案:
1. vanished
2. virtually
3. contrary
4. avid
5. ingrained
6. instinct

sense_groups.english: Steven Pinker, a cognitive psychologist best known for his book 'The Language Instinct', has called music 'auditory cheesecake, an exquisite confection crafted to tickle the sensitive spots of at least six of our mental faculties.'
sense_groups.chinese: 认知心理学家史蒂芬·平克以《语言本能》一书闻名，他将音乐称为‘听觉上的芝士蛋糕，一种精心制作的甜点，旨在刺激我们至少六种心智功能的敏感点。’

sense_groups.english: If it vanished from our species, he said, 'the rest of our lifestyle would be virtually unchanged.'
sense_groups.chinese: 他说，如果音乐从人类中消失，‘我们生活方式的其余部分将几乎不变。’

sense_groups.english: Others have argued that, on the contrary, music, along with art and literature, is part of what makes people human; its absence would have a brutalising effect.
sense_groups.chinese: 其他人则认为，恰恰相反，音乐与艺术和文学一样，是使人成为人的一部分；它的缺失会产生野蛮化的影响。

sense_groups.english: Philip Ball, a British science writer and an avid music enthusiast, comes down somewhere in the middle.
sense_groups.chinese: 英国科学作家兼狂热音乐爱好者菲利普·鲍尔持中间立场。

sense_groups.english: He says that music is ingrained in our auditory, cognitive and motor functions.
sense_groups.chinese: 他说，音乐深深植根于我们的听觉、认知和运动功能中。

sense_groups.english: We have a music instinct as much as a language instinct, and could not rid ourselves of it if we tried.
sense_groups.chinese: 我们拥有音乐本能，就像拥有语言本能一样，即使想摆脱也无法做到。

questions.name: #113 Higher Education Qualifications
questions.en:
Higher education qualifications provide a substantial ______ in the labour market.
Higher education ______ are less likely to be unemployed and ______ to have higher incomes than those without such qualifications.
Having a highly educated ______ can also lead to increased productivity and innovation and make Australia more ______ in the global market.
aggressive , higher , weakness , grudge , competitive , tend , graduates , advantage
questions.full:
Higher education qualifications provide a substantial ______ in the labour market.
Higher education ______ are less likely to be unemployed and ______ to have higher incomes than those without such qualifications.
Having a highly educated ______ can also lead to increased productivity and innovation and make Australia more ______ in the global market.

aggressive , higher , weakness , grudge , competitive , tend , graduates , advantage

答案:
1. advantage
2. graduates
3. tend
4. workforce
5. competitive

sense_groups.english: Higher education qualifications provide a substantial advantage in the labour market.
sense_groups.chinese: 高等教育学历在劳动力市场上提供了显著的优势。

sense_groups.english: Higher education graduates are less likely to be unemployed and tend to have higher incomes than those without such qualifications.
sense_groups.chinese: 高等教育毕业生失业的可能性较小，并且往往比没有此类学历的人收入更高。

sense_groups.english: Having a highly educated workforce can also lead to increased productivity and innovation and make Australia more competitive in the global market.
sense_groups.chinese: 拥有高学历的劳动力还可以提高生产力和创新能力，并使澳大利亚在全球市场上更具竞争力。

questions.name: #114 Just-in-time
questions.en:
'Just-in-time' is a management philosophy and not a technique.
It originally referred to the production of goods to meet customer ______ exactly, in time, quality and quantity, ______ the 'customer' is the final purchaser of the product or another process ______ along the production line.
It has now come to mean producing with ______ waste.
'Waste' is taken in its most general sense and includes time and resources as well as materials.
where , claim , demand , maximum , whether , further , minimum
questions.full:
'Just-in-time' is a management philosophy and not a technique.
It originally referred to the production of goods to meet customer ______ exactly, in time, quality and quantity, ______ the 'customer' is the final purchaser of the product or another process ______ along the production line.
It has now come to mean producing with ______ waste.
'Waste' is taken in its most general sense and includes time and resources as well as materials.

where , claim , demand , maximum , whether , further , minimum

答案:
1. demand
2. whether
3. further
4. minimum

sense_groups.english: 'Just-in-time' is a management philosophy and not a technique.
sense_groups.chinese: '准时制'是一种管理理念，而非技术。

sense_groups.english: It originally referred to the production of goods to meet customer demand exactly, in time, quality and quantity,
sense_groups.chinese: 它最初指的是生产商品以精确满足客户需求，在时间、质量和数量上都要恰到好处，

sense_groups.english: whether the 'customer' is the final purchaser of the product or another process further along the production line.
sense_groups.chinese: 无论'客户'是产品的最终购买者，还是生产线上的另一个后续工序。

sense_groups.english: It has now come to mean producing with minimum waste.
sense_groups.chinese: 现在它已意味着以最小浪费进行生产。

sense_groups.english: 'Waste' is taken in its most general sense and includes time and resources as well as materials.
sense_groups.chinese: '浪费'取其最广义，包括时间、资源以及材料。

questions.name: #115 Wolf's Perspective
questions.en:
From the wolf's perspective, this is clearly good news.
But it also had beneficial effects on the ecology of the park, according to a study published in 2004 by William Ripple and Robert Beschta from Oregon State University.
In their paper in Bio Science, the two researchers showed that reintroducing the wolves was ______ with increased growth of willow and cottonwood in the park.
Why?
Because grazing animals such as elk were ______ sites from which they couldn't easily escape, the scientists ______ .
And as the woody plants and trees grew taller and thicker, beaver ______ expanded.
interacted , claimed , avoiding , encountering , correlated , colonies , denied
questions.full:
From the wolf's perspective, this is clearly good news.
But it also had beneficial effects on the ecology of the park, according to a study published in 2004 by William Ripple and Robert Beschta from Oregon State University.
In their paper in Bio Science, the two researchers showed that reintroducing the wolves was ______ with increased growth of willow and cottonwood in the park.
Why?
Because grazing animals such as elk were ______ sites from which they couldn't easily escape, the scientists ______ .
And as the woody plants and trees grew taller and thicker, beaver ______ expanded.

interacted , claimed , avoiding , encountering , correlated , colonies , denied

答案:
1. correlated
2. avoiding
3. claimed
4. colonies

sense_groups.english: From the wolf's perspective, this is clearly good news.
sense_groups.chinese: 从狼的角度来看，这显然是好消息。

sense_groups.english: But it also had beneficial effects on the ecology of the park,
sense_groups.chinese: 但它也对公园的生态产生了有益的影响，

sense_groups.english: according to a study published in 2004 by William Ripple and Robert Beschta from Oregon State University.
sense_groups.chinese: 根据俄勒冈州立大学的威廉·里普尔和罗伯特·贝施塔在2004年发表的一项研究。

sense_groups.english: In their paper in Bio Science,
sense_groups.chinese: 在他们发表在《生物科学》上的论文中，

sense_groups.english: the two researchers showed that reintroducing the wolves was correlated with increased growth of willow and cottonwood in the park.
sense_groups.chinese: 两位研究人员表明，重新引入狼与公园内柳树和棉白杨的生长增加相关。

sense_groups.english: Why?
sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？

sense_groups.english: Because grazing animals such as elk were avoiding sites from which they couldn't easily escape,
sense_groups.chinese: 因为像麋鹿这样的食草动物会避开那些它们不容易逃脱的地点，

sense_groups.english: the scientists claimed.
sense_groups.chinese: 科学家们声称。

sense_groups.english: And as the woody plants and trees grew taller and thicker,
sense_groups.chinese: 随着木本植物和树木长得更高更粗壮，

sense_groups.english: beaver colonies expanded.
sense_groups.chinese: 海狸的群落扩大了。

questions.name: #116 Water and Land Temperature
questions.en:

And, ______ is a good absorber of the energy from the sun.
The land absorbs much of the sun's energy as well.
However, water heats up much more slowly than land and so the air above the land will be ______ compared to the air over the ocean.
The warm air over the land will rise throughout the day, causing low pressure at the surface.
Over the water, high surface pressure will form because of the colder air.
To ______ , the air will sink over the ocean.
The wind will blow from the higher pressure over the water to lower pressure over the land causing the sea breeze.
The sea breeze strength will vary depending on the temperature ______ between the land and the ocean.
chillier , warmer , complement , water , ocean , compensate , compliment , difference , affinity
questions.full:

And, ______ is a good absorber of the energy from the sun.

To ______ , the air will sink over the ocean.

The sea breeze strength will vary depending on the temperature ______ between the land and the ocean.

答案:
1. water
2. warmer
3. compensate

sense_groups.english: During the day, the sun heats up both the ocean surface and the land.

sense_groups.english: And, water is a good absorber of the energy from the sun.
sense_groups.chinese: 而且，水是太阳能量的良好吸收体。

sense_groups.english: The land absorbs much of the sun's energy as well.
sense_groups.chinese: 陆地也吸收了大量太阳能量。

sense_groups.english: However, water heats up much more slowly than land and so the air above the land will be warmer compared to the air over the ocean.
sense_groups.chinese: 然而，水比陆地升温慢得多，因此陆地上方的空气将比海洋上方的空气更温暖。

sense_groups.english: The warm air over the land will rise throughout the day, causing low pressure at the surface.
sense_groups.chinese: 陆地上方的暖空气在白天上升，导致地表形成低压。

sense_groups.english: Over the water, high surface pressure will form because of the colder air.
sense_groups.chinese: 在水面上，由于较冷的空气，会形成高压。

sense_groups.english: To compensate, the air will sink over the ocean.
sense_groups.chinese: 为了补偿，空气将在海洋上方下沉。

sense_groups.english: The wind will blow from the higher pressure over the water to lower pressure over the land causing the sea breeze.
sense_groups.chinese: 风将从水面的高压吹向陆地的低压，形成海风。

sense_groups.english: The sea breeze strength will vary depending on the temperature difference between the land and the ocean.
sense_groups.chinese: 海风的强度将根据陆地和海洋之间的温差而变化。

sense_groups.english: Colorful poison frogs in the Amazon owe their great diversity to ancestors that leapt into the region from the Andes Mountains several times during the last 10 million years, a new study from The University of Texas at Austin suggests.
sense_groups.chinese: 亚马逊色彩斑斓的毒蛙之所以拥有巨大的多样性，要归功于过去1000万年间多次从安第斯山脉跳入该地区的祖先，德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校的一项新研究表明。

sense_groups.chinese: 这是首次研究表明安第斯山脉一直是亚马逊盆地多样性的主要来源，而亚马逊盆地是地球上最大的生物多样性宝库之一。

sense_groups.english: We have shown that you cannot understand Amazonian biodiversity by looking only in the basin.

sense_groups.english: Adjacent regions have played a major role."

Normally the regular contracting and releasing of these little segments circulates blood in the capillaries that supply them (the segments) with their nutrients.

sense_groups.english: The trigger point causes the rest of the fiber segments to be stretched to capacity.
sense_groups.chinese: 触发点导致其余纤维段被拉伸到极限。

sense_groups.english: It becomes a tight band.

questions.en:

sense_groups.english: Disadvantage in early childhood poses multiple risks to children's development.
sense_groups.chinese: 早期童年劣势对儿童发展构成多重风险。

sense_groups.chinese: 诸如低社会经济地位、父母长期失业和社会孤立等因素，可能对儿童实现其全部潜力的机会产生持久影响。

questions.full:

To this end, ______ are drawn with the philosophy of control favored by the Party in Orwell's Nineteen Eighty-Four.

2. compared
3. conditional
4. attention

sense_groups.english: The article subjects the assumptions and prescriptions of the 'Corporate Culture' literature to critical scrutiny.
sense_groups.chinese: 这篇文章对‘企业文化’文献中的假设和处方进行了批判性审视。

sense_groups.english: The body of the article is devoted to teasing out the distinctive basis of its appeal compared with earlier management theory.
sense_groups.chinese: 文章的主体部分致力于梳理其与早期管理理论相比的独特吸引力基础。

sense_groups.english: It is seen to build upon earlier efforts (eg 'theory Y') to constitute a self-disciplining form of employee subjectivity by asserting that 'practical autonomy' is conditional upon the development of a strong corporate culture.
sense_groups.chinese: 它被认为建立在早期努力（如‘Y理论’）之上，通过断言‘实际自主性’以强大企业文化的发展为条件，来构成一种自我规训的员工主体性形式。

sense_groups.english: The paper illuminates the dark side of this project by drawing attention to the subjugating and totalitarian implications of its excellence/quality prescriptions.
sense_groups.chinese: 本文通过引起对其卓越/质量处方中压制性和极权主义含义的关注，揭示了这一项目的阴暗面。

sense_groups.chinese: 为此，本文与奥威尔《一九八四》中该党所青睐的控制哲学进行了类比。

sense_groups.english: Specifically, the paper critiques the 'doublethink' contention that autonomy can be realized in monocultural conditions that systematically constrain opportunities to wrestle with competing values standpoints and their associated life projects.
sense_groups.chinese: 具体来说，本文批判了‘双重思想’的主张，即自主性可以在系统性地限制与竞争性价值观立场及其相关生活计划进行斗争的机会的单文化条件下实现。

questions.name: #131 Concept of Culture
questions.en:

questions.full:
Many people today think of culture in the way that it was thought of in Europe during the 18th and early 19th centuries.

sense_groups.english: Many people today think of culture in the way that it was thought of in Europe during the 18th and early 19th centuries.

sense_groups.chinese: 这种文化概念反映了欧洲社会及其全球殖民地内部的不平等。

sense_groups.english: This understanding of culture equates culture with civilization and contrasts both with nature or non-civilization.
sense_groups.chinese: 这种对文化的理解将文化等同于文明，并将两者与自然或非文明相对立。

sense_groups.english: According to this understanding of culture, some countries are more civilized than others, and some people are more cultured than others.

sense_groups.chinese: 任何不符合这一类别的东西都被贴上混乱或无政府的标签。

sense_groups.english: From this perspective, culture is closely tied to cultivation, which is the progressive refinement of human behavior.

sense_groups.english: In practice, culture referred to elite goods and activities such as haute cuisine, high fashion or haute couture, museum-caliber art and classical music.

sense_groups.english: The word cultured referred to people who knew about and took part in these activities.
sense_groups.chinese: “有文化”这个词指的是了解并参与这些活动的人。

questions.full:

But the reader is confronted by line upon line of printed symbols, without benefits of physical ______ and emphasis or the possibility of dialogue or discussion.

答案:

2. little
3. cut
4. converging
5. tone

sense_groups.chinese: 作者——或者说，说话者——将他的思想视为一个整体，但必须用一连串的词语来表达；

sense_groups.chinese: 读者——或听者——必须接受这一连串的符号，并从中重建思想的原始整体性。

sense_groups.english: There is little difficulty in conversation, because the listener receives innumerable cues from the physical expressions of the speaker;
sense_groups.chinese: 在对话中几乎没有困难，因为听者从说话者的身体表达中接收到无数线索；

sense_groups.chinese: 存在对话，听者可以随时插话。

sense_groups.english: The advantage of group discussion is that people can overcome linear sequence of words by converging on ideas from different directions;
sense_groups.chinese: 小组讨论的优势在于，人们可以通过从不同方向汇聚观点来克服词语的线性顺序；

sense_groups.english: which makes for wholeness of thought.
sense_groups.chinese: 这有助于思想的整体性。

sense_groups.english: But the reader is confronted by line upon line of printed symbols, without benefits of physical tone and emphasis or the possibility of dialogue or discussion.
sense_groups.chinese: 但读者面对的是成行成行的印刷符号，没有身体语调和强调的好处，也没有对话或讨论的可能性。

sense_groups.english: The amount of sleep you need depends on many factors, especially your age.
sense_groups.chinese: 你需要的睡眠量取决于许多因素，尤其是你的年龄。

sense_groups.english: Newborns sleep between 16 and 18 hours a day and preschool children should sleep between 10 and 12 hours.
sense_groups.chinese: 新生儿每天睡16到18小时，学龄前儿童应睡10到12小时。

sense_groups.english: Older children and teens need at least nine hours to be well rested.
sense_groups.chinese: 大一点的孩子和青少年需要至少九小时才能充分休息。

sense_groups.english: For most adults, seven to eight hours a night appears to the best amount of sleep.
sense_groups.chinese: 对大多数成年人来说，每晚七到八小时似乎是最佳睡眠量。

sense_groups.english: However, for some people "enough sleep" may be as few as five hours or as many as 10 hours of sleep.
sense_groups.chinese: 然而，对一些人来说，“足够的睡眠”可能少至五小时或多至十小时。

sense_groups.english: As you get older, your sleeping patterns change.
sense_groups.chinese: 随着年龄增长，你的睡眠模式会改变。

sense_groups.english: Older adults tend to sleep more lightly and awaken more frequently in the night than younger adults.
sense_groups.chinese: 老年人往往比年轻人睡得更浅，夜间更容易醒来。

sense_groups.english: This can have many causes including medical conditions and medications used to treat them.
sense_groups.chinese: 这可能有多种原因，包括疾病和治疗药物。

sense_groups.english: But there’s no evidence that older adults need less sleep than younger adults.
sense_groups.chinese: 但没有证据表明老年人比年轻人需要更少的睡眠。

sense_groups.english: Getting enough sleep is important to your health because it boosts your immune system, which makes your body better able to fight disease.
sense_groups.chinese: 获得足够睡眠对你的健康很重要，因为它能增强你的免疫系统，使你的身体更好地抵抗疾病。

sense_groups.english: Sleep is necessary for your nervous system to work properly.
sense_groups.chinese: 睡眠对于你的神经系统正常工作必不可少。

sense_groups.english: Too little sleep makes you drowsy and unable to concentrate.
sense_groups.chinese: 睡眠太少会让你昏昏欲睡，无法集中注意力。

sense_groups.english: It also impairs memory and physical performance.
sense_groups.chinese: 它还会损害记忆力和身体表现。

sense_groups.english: So how many hours of sleep are enough for You?
sense_groups.chinese: 那么，多少小时的睡眠对你来说足够呢？

sense_groups.english: Experts say that if you feel drowsy during the day — even during boring activities - you are not getting enough sleep.
sense_groups.chinese: 专家说，如果你白天感到困倦——即使在无聊的活动中——说明你睡眠不足。

sense_groups.english: Also, quality of sleep is just as important as quantity.
sense_groups.chinese: 此外，睡眠质量和数量同样重要。

sense_groups.english: People whose sleep is frequently interrupted or cut short are not getting quality sleep.
sense_groups.chinese: 睡眠频繁被打断或缩短的人没有得到高质量的睡眠。

sense_groups.english: If you experience frequent daytime sleepiness, even after increasing the amount of quality sleep you get, talk to your doctor.
sense_groups.chinese: 如果你经常白天犯困，即使增加了高质量睡眠的量，也要咨询医生。

sense_groups.english: He or she may be able to identify the cause of sleep problems and offer advice on how to get a better night’s sleep.
sense_groups.chinese: 他或她可能能够找出睡眠问题的原因，并就如何获得更好的夜间睡眠提供建议。

questions.full:

sense_groups.english: For too long we have held preconceived notions of ‘the’ market and ‘the’ state
sense_groups.chinese: 长久以来，我们对‘市场’和‘国家’持有先入为主的观念

sense_groups.chinese: 这些观念似乎独立于当地社会和文化。

sense_groups.english: The debate about civil society ultimately is about how culture, market and state relate to each other.
sense_groups.chinese: 关于公民社会的辩论最终是关于文化、市场和国家如何相互关联。

sense_groups.english: Concern about civil society, however, is not only relevant to central and eastern Europe and the developing world.
sense_groups.chinese: 然而，对公民社会的关注不仅与中欧、东欧和发展中国家有关。

sense_groups.english: It is very much of interest to the European Union as well.
sense_groups.chinese: 欧盟对此也非常感兴趣。

sense_groups.english: The Civil Dialogue Initiated by the Commission in the 1990s was a first attempt by the EU to give the institutions of society - and not only governments and businesses - a voice at the policy-making tables in Brussels.
sense_groups.chinese: 欧盟委员会在20世纪90年代发起的公民对话是欧盟首次尝试让社会机构——而不仅仅是政府和企业——在布鲁塞尔的决策桌上发声。

sense_groups.english: The EU, like other international institutions, has a long way to go in trying to accommodate the frequently divergent interests of non-governmental organizations and citizen groups.
sense_groups.chinese: 与其他国际机构一样，欧盟在努力协调非政府组织和公民团体经常分歧的利益方面还有很长的路要走。

sense_groups.english: There is increasing recognition that international and national governments have to open up to civil society institutions.
sense_groups.chinese: 人们越来越认识到，国际和各国政府必须向公民社会机构开放。

questions.full:

questions.name: #152 Electorate
questions.en:
It would be reassuring to think that the ______ choose who to vote for based on the candidates' track records and future policy promises.
  ______ ______ , many of us are swayed simply by the way that politicians look.
Consider a 2009 study that asked Swiss students to look at multiple pairs of unfamiliar French political candidates and in each case to select the one who looked most competent.
Most of the time, the candidate selected by students as ______ the most competent was also the one who'd had real life electoral success, the implication ______ that voters too had been swayed by the candidates' appearance (there’s little evidence that appearance and competence actually ______ ).
Unsurprisingly, being attractive also helps win votes, especially in war time (in peacetime, looking trustworthy is more of an advantage).
Other research has shown that we're more likely to vote for male and female candidates with deeper voices.
In truth , in conclusion , as looking , correlate , associate , implication being , electorate
questions.answer:
1. electorate
2. In
3. truth
4. looking
5. being
6. correlate
questions.full:
It would be reassuring to think that the ______ choose who to vote for based on the candidates' track records and future policy promises.
  ______ ______ , many of us are swayed simply by the way that politicians look.
Consider a 2009 study that asked Swiss students to look at multiple pairs of unfamiliar French political candidates and in each case to select the one who looked most competent.
Most of the time, the candidate selected by students as ______ the most competent was also the one who'd had real life electoral success, the implication ______ that voters too had been swayed by the candidates' appearance (there’s little evidence that appearance and competence actually ______ ).
Unsurprisingly, being attractive also helps win votes, especially in war time (in peacetime, looking trustworthy is more of an advantage).
Other research has shown that we're more likely to vote for male and female candidates with deeper voices.

In truth , in conclusion , as looking , correlate , associate , implication being , electorate

答案:
1. electorate
2. In
3. truth
4. looking
5. being
6. correlate

sense_groups.english: It would be reassuring to think that the electorate choose who to vote for based on the candidates' track records and future policy promises.
sense_groups.chinese: 如果认为选民是根据候选人的过往记录和未来政策承诺来选择投票对象，那会让人感到安心。

sense_groups.english: In truth, many of us are swayed simply by the way that politicians look.
sense_groups.chinese: 事实上，我们很多人仅仅因为政治家的外表而受到影响。

sense_groups.english: Consider a 2009 study that asked Swiss students to look at multiple pairs of unfamiliar French political candidates and in each case to select the one who looked most competent.
sense_groups.chinese: 以2009年的一项研究为例，该研究要求瑞士学生观看多对不熟悉的法国政治候选人，并在每种情况下选择看起来最能干的那一位。

sense_groups.english: Most of the time, the candidate selected by students as looking the most competent was also the one who'd had real life electoral success, the implication being that voters too had been swayed by the candidates' appearance (there’s little evidence that appearance and competence actually correlate).
sense_groups.chinese: 大多数时候，学生选出的看起来最能干的候选人也是在现实中选举获胜的那位，这暗示选民也受到了候选人外表的影响（几乎没有证据表明外表和能力实际上相关）。

sense_groups.english: Unsurprisingly, being attractive also helps win votes, especially in war time (in peacetime, looking trustworthy is more of an advantage).
sense_groups.chinese: 毫不意外，有吸引力也有助于赢得选票，尤其是在战时（在和平时期，看起来值得信赖更占优势）。

sense_groups.english: Other research has shown that we're more likely to vote for male and female candidates with deeper voices.
sense_groups.chinese: 其他研究表明，我们更可能投票给声音低沉的男性和女性候选人。

questions.name: #153 Jupiter’s Moon Europa
questions.en:
Scientists preparing for NASA's proposed Jupiter icy Moons Orbiter believe that Jupiter's moons Europa may be a corrosive mixture of acid and peroxide.
Thus, it may not be the ______ place for life to exist as was thought possibly to be the case.
  ______ , all the information we have about Europa comes from the spacecraft Galileo, which completed its mission to study.
  ______ the general perception of Europa is of a frozen crust of water ice harboring a salty subterranean ocean kilometer below, researchers studying the most ______ measurements say light reflected from the moons icy surface bears the spectral fingerprints of hydrogen peroxide and strong acids.
  ______ , they accept that it could just be a thin surface dusting and might not come from the ocean below.
ideal , recent , ideally , Virtually , actually , Although , Whatsoever , However , thus
questions.full:
Scientists preparing for NASA's proposed Jupiter icy Moons Orbiter believe that Jupiter's moons Europa may be a corrosive mixture of acid and peroxide.
Thus, it may not be the ______ place for life to exist as was thought possibly to be the case.
  ______ , all the information we have about Europa comes from the spacecraft Galileo, which completed its mission to study.
  ______ the general perception of Europa is of a frozen crust of water ice harboring a salty subterranean ocean kilometer below, researchers studying the most ______ measurements say light reflected from the moons icy surface bears the spectral fingerprints of hydrogen peroxide and strong acids.
  ______ , they accept that it could just be a thin surface dusting and might not come from the ocean below.

ideal , recent , ideally , Virtually , actually , Although , Whatsoever , However , thus

答案:
1. ideal
2. Virtually
3. Although
4. recent
5. However

sense_groups.english: Scientists preparing for NASA's proposed Jupiter icy Moons Orbiter believe that Jupiter's moons Europa may be a corrosive mixture of acid and peroxide.
sense_groups.chinese: 为NASA拟议的木星冰卫星轨道器做准备的科学家们认为，木星的卫星欧罗巴可能是一种酸和过氧化物的腐蚀性混合物。

sense_groups.english: Thus, it may not be the ideal place for life to exist as was thought possibly to be the case.
sense_groups.chinese: 因此，它可能不是人们曾经认为的可能存在生命的理想地点。

sense_groups.english: Virtually, all the information we have about Europa comes from the spacecraft Galileo, which completed its mission to study.
sense_groups.chinese: 实际上，我们关于欧罗巴的所有信息都来自伽利略号航天器，它完成了研究任务。

sense_groups.english: Although the general perception of Europa is of a frozen crust of water ice harboring a salty subterranean ocean kilometer below, researchers studying the most recent measurements say light reflected from the moons icy surface bears the spectral fingerprints of hydrogen peroxide and strong acids.
sense_groups.chinese: 尽管对欧罗巴的普遍看法是，它有一个水冰的冰冻地壳，下面藏着一公里深的咸地下海洋，但研究最新测量结果的科学家表示，从卫星冰面反射的光带有过氧化氢和强酸的光谱指纹。

sense_groups.english: However, they accept that it could just be a thin surface dusting and might not come from the ocean below.
sense_groups.chinese: 然而，他们承认这可能只是表面的一层薄薄的灰尘，可能并非来自下面的海洋。

questions.name: #154 The Gray Wolf
questions.en:
After an absence of more than 50 years, the gray wolf (Canis lupus) once again runs beneath the night skies of Yellowstone National Park.
At 3: 45 pm on March 21st 1995, the first of three groups of gray wolves (also known as the timber wolf) were released from ______ acclimation pens at Crystal Creek within Yellowstone National Park.

fenced , separate , involved , resulted , consecutive , minimizing , forced , cutting , following
questions.full:
After an absence of more than 50 years, the gray wolf (Canis lupus) once again runs beneath the night skies of Yellowstone National Park.
At 3: 45 pm on March 21st 1995, the first of three groups of gray wolves (also known as the timber wolf) were released from ______ acclimation pens at Crystal Creek within Yellowstone National Park.
The wolf release plan, ______ in an environmental impact statement (EIS) in 1992-1994, is to restore wolves to Yellowstone and central Idaho by establishing experimental populations of gray wolves in both areas.

sense_groups.english: After an absence of more than 50 years, the gray wolf (Canis lupus) once again runs beneath the night skies of Yellowstone National Park.
sense_groups.chinese: 在消失了50多年后，灰狼（学名Canis lupus）再次奔跑在黄石国家公园的夜空下。

sense_groups.english: At 3:45 pm on March 21st 1995, the first of three groups of gray wolves (also known as the timber wolf) were released from fenced acclimation pens at Crystal Creek within Yellowstone National Park.
sense_groups.chinese: 1995年3月21日下午3点45分，三组灰狼（也称为森林狼）中的第一批从黄石国家公园内水晶溪的围栏适应围场中被释放。

sense_groups.english: The wolf release plan, involved in an environmental impact statement (EIS) in 1992-1994, is to restore wolves to Yellowstone and central Idaho by establishing experimental populations of gray wolves in both areas.
sense_groups.chinese: 这项狼释放计划，涉及1992-1994年的环境影响报告书，旨在通过在黄石和爱达荷中部建立灰狼实验种群，将狼恢复到这两个地区。

sense_groups.english: The goal for Yellowstone is to establish 10 packs wolves reproducing in the area for three consecutive years by the year 2002.
sense_groups.chinese: 黄石的目标是到2002年，在该地区建立10个狼群，并连续三年繁殖。

sense_groups.english: Restoring wolves to Yellowstone is in keeping with national park goals to perpetuate all native species and their natural interactions with their environment.
sense_groups.chinese: 将狼恢复到黄石符合国家公园的目标，即永久保留所有本地物种及其与环境的自然互动。

sense_groups.english: As with other park wildlife programs, management emphasizes minimizing human impact on natural animal population dynamics.
sense_groups.chinese: 与其他公园野生动物项目一样，管理强调尽量减少人类对自然动物种群动态的影响。

sense_groups.english: Yellowstone National Park is a wilderness and wildlife refuge in the United States.
sense_groups.chinese: 黄石国家公园是美国的一个荒野和野生动物保护区。

questions.name: #155 Fresh Water

That's about 4, 300,000 cubic kilometers of freshwater to share out between most of the plants, animals & people on the planet.

questions.full:

questions.name: #157 Fall of Smallpox
questions.en:
The fall of smallpox began with the realization that ______ of the disease were immune for the rest of their lives.
This led to the practice of variolation- a process of exposing a healthy person to infected material from a person with smallpox in the hopes of producing a mild disease that ______ immunity from further infection.
The first written account of variolation describes a Buddhist nun practicing around 1022 to 1063 AD.
By the 1700s, this method of variolation was ______ practice in China, India, and Turkey.
In the late 1700s European physicians used this and other methods of variolation, but reported “devastating” results in some cases.
Overall, 2% to 3% of people who were variolated died of smallpox, but this practice decreased the total number of smallpox ______ by 10-fold.
predators , survivors , offer , provided , common , sheltered , fatalities , fatalism
questions.full:
The fall of smallpox began with the realization that ______ of the disease were immune for the rest of their lives.
This led to the practice of variolation- a process of exposing a healthy person to infected material from a person with smallpox in the hopes of producing a mild disease that ______ immunity from further infection.
The first written account of variolation describes a Buddhist nun practicing around 1022 to 1063 AD.
By the 1700s, this method of variolation was ______ practice in China, India, and Turkey.
In the late 1700s European physicians used this and other methods of variolation, but reported “devastating” results in some cases.
Overall, 2% to 3% of people who were variolated died of smallpox, but this practice decreased the total number of smallpox ______ by 10-fold.

predators , survivors , offer , provided , common , sheltered , fatalities , fatalism

答案:
1. survivors
2. provided
3. common
4. fatalities

sense_groups.english: The fall of smallpox began with the realization that survivors of the disease were immune for the rest of their lives.
sense_groups.chinese: 天花的衰落始于人们意识到这种疾病的幸存者终身免疫。

sense_groups.english: This led to the practice of variolation- a process of exposing a healthy person to infected material from a person with smallpox in the hopes of producing a mild disease that provided immunity from further infection.
sense_groups.chinese: 这导致了人痘接种术的实践——一种将健康人暴露于天花患者的感染物质中，希望产生轻微疾病从而提供对后续感染免疫力的过程。

sense_groups.english: The first written account of variolation describes a Buddhist nun practicing around 1022 to 1063 AD.
sense_groups.chinese: 关于人痘接种术的第一份书面记载描述了一位佛教尼姑在公元1022年至1063年左右实施该术。

sense_groups.english: By the 1700s, this method of variolation was common practice in China, India, and Turkey.
sense_groups.chinese: 到18世纪，这种人痘接种法在中国、印度和土耳其已成为常见做法。

sense_groups.english: In the late 1700s European physicians used this and other methods of variolation, but reported “devastating” results in some cases.
sense_groups.chinese: 18世纪末，欧洲医生使用了这种及其他人痘接种方法，但报告称在某些情况下结果“毁灭性”。

sense_groups.english: Overall, 2% to 3% of people who were variolated died of smallpox, but this practice decreased the total number of smallpox fatalities by 10-fold.
sense_groups.chinese: 总体而言，2%到3%接受人痘接种的人死于天花，但这一做法使天花死亡总数减少了10倍。

questions.name: #158 Sociology
questions.en:
Sociology is, in very basic terms, the study of human societies.

Sociology therefore, has a reasonably long history of development, (150-200 years) ______ in Britain it has only been in the last 30-40 years that sociology as an examined subject in the education system has achieved a level of importance equivalent to, or above, most of the other subjects it is possible to study.

questions.full:

questions.full:
The study of objects constitutes a relatively new field of academic enquiry, commonly referred to as material culture studies.
Students of material culture seek to understand societies, both past and present, through careful study and ______ of the physical or material objects generated by those societies.
The source material for study is exceptionally wide, ______ not just human-made artefacts but also natural objects and even preserved body parts (as you saw in the film 'Encountering a body’).

  ______ ______ ______ , objects are all scholars have to rely on in forming an understanding of ancient peoples.
Even where written documents survive, the physical remains of literate cultures often help to provide new and interesting insights into how people once lived and thought, ______ ______ the case of medieval and post-medieval archaeology.

sense_groups.english: The study of objects constitutes a relatively new field of academic enquiry, commonly referred to as material culture studies.
sense_groups.chinese: 对物品的研究构成了一个相对较新的学术领域，通常被称为物质文化研究。

sense_groups.english: Students of material culture seek to understand societies, both past and present, through careful study and observation of the physical or material objects generated by those societies.
sense_groups.chinese: 物质文化的研究者试图通过仔细研究和观察这些社会产生的物理或物质物品，来理解过去和现在的社会。

sense_groups.english: The source material for study is exceptionally wide, including not just human-made artefacts but also natural objects and even preserved body parts (as you saw in the film 'Encountering a body’).
sense_groups.chinese: 研究的素材范围极其广泛，不仅包括人造物品，还包括自然物体甚至保存的身体部位（正如你在电影《遇见一具尸体》中看到的）。

sense_groups.english: Some specialists in the field of material culture have made bold claims for its pre-eminence.
sense_groups.chinese: 物质文化领域的一些专家对其优越性提出了大胆的主张。

sense_groups.english: In certain disciplines, it reigns supreme.

sense_groups.english: In analysing the physical remains of societies, both past and present, historians, archaeologists, anthropologists and others have been careful to remind us that objects mean different things to different people.
sense_groups.chinese: 在分析过去和现在的社会物理遗存时，历史学家、考古学家、人类学家等一直谨慎地提醒我们，物品对不同的人意味着不同的东西。

questions.name: #161 Plants and Animals
questions.en:
From the earliest civilisations, plants and animals have been portrayed as a means of understanding and recording the potential uses, such as their economic and healing properties.

questions.full:
From the earliest civilisations, plants and animals have been portrayed as a means of understanding and recording the potential uses, such as their economic and healing properties.
From the first illustrated ______ of medicinal plants, De Materia Medica by Dioscorides, in the first century through to the late fourteenth century the illustration of plants and animals changed very little.

Then, with the emergence of artists such as Albrecht Durer and Leonardo Da Vinci, naturalists such as Otto Brunfels, Leonhard Fuchs in botany and Conrad Gesner and Ulisse Aldrovandi in zoology, nature began to be depicted in a more realistic style.
Individual living plants or animals were observed directly and their likeness rendered onto paper or vellum.

catalogue , statement , popularity , number , accurate , dictated  , rendered

答案:
1. catalogue
2. popularity
3. accurate

sense_groups.english: From the earliest civilisations, plants and animals have been portrayed as a means of understanding and recording the potential uses, such as their economic and healing properties.
sense_groups.chinese: 从最早的文明开始，植物和动物就被描绘成理解和记录其潜在用途（如经济和治疗特性）的一种方式。

sense_groups.english: From the first illustrated catalogue of medicinal plants, De Materia Medica by Dioscorides, in the first century through to the late fourteenth century the illustration of plants and animals changed very little.
sense_groups.chinese: 从公元一世纪迪奥斯克里德斯所著的《药物学》——第一部带插图的药用植物目录——一直到十四世纪末，植物和动物的插图几乎没有变化。

sense_groups.english: Woodcuts in instructional manuals and herbals were often repeatedly copied over the centuries, resulting in a loss of definition and accuracy so that they became little more than stylized decoration.
sense_groups.chinese: 几个世纪以来，教学手册和草药书中的木刻版画经常被反复复制，导致清晰度和准确性丧失，最终它们几乎变成了程式化的装饰。

sense_groups.english: With the growing popularity of copperplate engravings, the traditional use of woodcuts declined and the representation of plants and animals became more accurate.
sense_groups.chinese: 随着铜版画越来越受欢迎，木刻版画的传统用途逐渐衰落，植物和动物的描绘变得更加准确。

sense_groups.english: Then, with the emergence of artists such as Albrecht Durer and Leonardo Da Vinci, naturalists such as Otto Brunfels, Leonhard Fuchs in botany and Conrad Gesner and Ulisse Aldrovandi in zoology, nature began to be depicted in a more realistic style.
sense_groups.chinese: 随后，随着阿尔布雷特·丢勒和列奥纳多·达·芬奇等艺术家，以及植物学领域的奥托·布伦费尔斯、莱昂哈德·福克斯，动物学领域的康拉德·格斯纳和乌利塞·阿尔德罗万迪等博物学家的出现，自然开始以更写实的风格被描绘。

sense_groups.english: Individual living plants or animals were observed directly and their likeness rendered onto paper or vellum.
sense_groups.chinese: 个体活体植物或动物被直接观察，它们的形象被绘制到纸或羊皮纸上。

The seeds of trees such as the maple have a single-blade structure that ______ them to fly far away and drift safely to the ground.
These seeds, known as samaras, need no engine to ______ through the air, thanks to a process called autorotation.
By analyzing the behavior of the samara with high-speed cameras, Ulrich and his team were able to copy its design.
The samara copter is not the first single-winged helicopter – one was flown in 1952, and others have been attempted since – but it is the first to take advantage of the samara's autorotation.

questions.name: #218 DNA Barcoding
questions.en:
DNA barcoding was invented by Paul Hebert of the University of Guelph, in Ontario, Canada, in 2003.
His idea was to ______ a unique identification tag for each species based on a short stretch of DNA.
Separating species would then be a simple task of sequencing this tiny bit of DNA.
Dr. Hebert proposed part of a gene called cytochrome oxidase I ( COI) as suitable to the task.
All animals have it.
It seems to vary enough, but not too much, to act as a reliable marker, and it is easily ______ , because it is one of a handful of genes found outside the cell nucleus, in structures called mitochondria.
The idea worked, and it has dramatically reduced the time ( to less than an hour) and expense (to less than $2) of using DNA to identify species.
And thus, in July this year, Dr. Victor' s mystery goby became Coryphopterus Kuna.
It was the first vertebrate to have its DNA barcode-a sequence of about 600 genetic 'letters' -included in its official description.
Barcoding has taken off rapidly since Dr. Hebert invented it.
When the idea was proposed, it was expected to be a ______ to taxonomists trying to name the world's millions of species.
It has, however, proved to have a far wider range of uses than the merely academic-most promisingly in the realm of public health.
One health-related project is the Mosquito Barcoding Initiative being run by Yvonne-Marie Linton of the Natural History Museum in London.
This aims to barcode 80% of the world's mosquitoes within the next two years, to help control mosquito-borne diseases.
Mosquitoes are ______ for half a billion malarial infections and 1m deaths every year.
They also ______ devastating diseases such as yellow fever, West Nile fever, and dengue.
However, efforts to control them are consistently ______ by the difficulty and expense of identifying mosquitoes—of, which there are at least 3,500 species, many of them hard to tell apart.
operate , responsible , transmit , boon , boost , undermined , vital , extracted , injected , generate
questions.answer:
1. generate
2. extracted
3. boon
4. responsible
5. transmit
6. undermined
questions.full:

His idea was to ______ a unique identification tag for each species based on a short stretch of DNA.
Separating species would then be a simple task of sequencing this tiny bit of DNA.

All animals have it.
It seems to vary enough, but not too much, to act as a reliable marker, and it is easily ______ , because it is one of a handful of genes found outside the cell nucleus, in structures called mitochondria.
The idea worked, and it has dramatically reduced the time ( to less than an hour) and expense (to less than $2) of using DNA to identify species.
And thus, in July this year, Dr. Victor' s mystery goby became Coryphopterus Kuna.
It was the first vertebrate to have its DNA barcode-a sequence of about 600 genetic 'letters' -included in its official description.
Barcoding has taken off rapidly since Dr. Hebert invented it.
When the idea was proposed, it was expected to be a ______ to taxonomists trying to name the world's millions of species.
It has, however, proved to have a far wider range of uses than the merely academic-most promisingly in the realm of public health.

This aims to barcode 80% of the world's mosquitoes within the next two years, to help control mosquito-borne diseases.

答案:
1. generate
2. extracted
3. boon
4. responsible
5. transmit
6. undermined

sense_groups.english: DNA barcoding was invented by Paul Hebert of the University of Guelph, in Ontario, Canada, in 2003.
sense_groups.chinese: DNA条形码是由加拿大安大略省圭尔夫大学的保罗·赫伯特于2003年发明的。

sense_groups.english: His idea was to generate a unique identification tag for each species based on a short stretch of DNA.
sense_groups.chinese: 他的想法是基于一小段DNA为每个物种生成一个独特的识别标签。

sense_groups.english: Separating species would then be a simple task of sequencing this tiny bit of DNA.
sense_groups.chinese: 然后区分物种就变成了测序这一小段DNA的简单任务。

sense_groups.english: Dr. Hebert proposed part of a gene called cytochrome oxidase I (COI) as suitable to the task.
sense_groups.chinese: 赫伯特博士提出，一种名为细胞色素氧化酶I（COI）的基因的一部分适合这项任务。

sense_groups.english: All animals have it.
sense_groups.chinese: 所有动物都有这个基因。

sense_groups.english: It seems to vary enough, but not too much, to act as a reliable marker, and it is easily extracted, because it is one of a handful of genes found outside the cell nucleus, in structures called mitochondria.
sense_groups.chinese: 它似乎变异足够多，但又不太多，可以作为可靠的标记，而且很容易提取，因为它是少数存在于细胞核外、在线粒体结构中的基因之一。

sense_groups.english: The idea worked, and it has dramatically reduced the time (to less than an hour) and expense (to less than $2) of using DNA to identify species.
sense_groups.chinese: 这个想法奏效了，它大大减少了使用DNA识别物种的时间（不到一小时）和费用（不到2美元）。

sense_groups.english: And thus, in July this year, Dr. Victor's mystery goby became Coryphopterus Kuna.
sense_groups.chinese: 因此，今年7月，维克多博士的神秘虾虎鱼被命名为Coryphopterus Kuna。

sense_groups.english: It was the first vertebrate to have its DNA barcode—a sequence of about 600 genetic 'letters'—included in its official description.
sense_groups.chinese: 它是第一种在其正式描述中包含DNA条形码（约600个遗传“字母”的序列）的脊椎动物。

sense_groups.english: Barcoding has taken off rapidly since Dr. Hebert invented it.
sense_groups.chinese: 自赫伯特博士发明以来，条形码技术迅速发展。

sense_groups.english: When the idea was proposed, it was expected to be a boon to taxonomists trying to name the world's millions of species.
sense_groups.chinese: 当这个想法被提出时，它被期望成为试图命名世界上数百万物种的分类学家的福音。

sense_groups.english: It has, however, proved to have a far wider range of uses than the merely academic—most promisingly in the realm of public health.
sense_groups.chinese: 然而，它已被证明具有比仅仅学术用途更广泛的应用——最有前景的是在公共卫生领域。

sense_groups.english: One health-related project is the Mosquito Barcoding Initiative being run by Yvonne-Marie Linton of the Natural History Museum in London.
sense_groups.chinese: 一个与健康相关的项目是伦敦自然历史博物馆的伊冯娜-玛丽·林顿正在进行的蚊子条形码计划。

sense_groups.english: This aims to barcode 80% of the world's mosquitoes within the next two years, to help control mosquito-borne diseases.
sense_groups.chinese: 该计划旨在未来两年内对世界上80%的蚊子进行条形码编码，以帮助控制蚊媒疾病。

sense_groups.english: Mosquitoes are responsible for half a billion malarial infections and 1m deaths every year.
sense_groups.chinese: 蚊子每年导致5亿例疟疾感染和100万人死亡。

sense_groups.english: They also transmit devastating diseases such as yellow fever, West Nile fever, and dengue.
sense_groups.chinese: 它们还传播黄热病、西尼罗热和登革热等毁灭性疾病。

sense_groups.english: However, efforts to control them are consistently undermined by the difficulty and expense of identifying mosquitoes—of which there are at least 3,500 species, many of them hard to tell apart.
sense_groups.chinese: 然而，控制它们的努力一直因识别蚊子的困难和费用而受到削弱——蚊子至少有3500种，其中许多很难区分。

questions.name: #219 Gas Drilling
questions.en:

In a report released on January 23, a team of British researchers says the deadly ______ began when an exploratory gas well punched through a layer of rock 9300 feet (2800 meters) below the surface, ______ hot, high pressure water to ______ .

The mud volcano is similar to a gusher or blowout, which occur in oil drilling when oil or gas squirt to the surface, team says.
This upwelling, however, spews out a volume of mud equivalent to a dozen Olympic swimming pools each day.
Although the eruption isn't as violent as a ______ volcano, more than a dozen people died when a natural gas pipeline ruptured.
The research team, who published their findings in the February issue of GSA Today, also estimate that the volcano, called Lusi, will leave more than 11,000 people permanently displaced.
triggered , runoff , transforming , allowing , rinsed , provide , spread , upwelling , happened , escape , range , conventional

4. escape

There was also a library that was crammed with books -- two of Jack' s favorites were Treasure Island by Robert Louis Stevenson and The Secret Garden by Frances Hodgson Burnett.
This somewhat idyllic boyhood came to an end for Lewis when his mother became ill and died of cancer in 1908.

Lewis hated the school with its strict rules and hard ______ headmaster, and he missed Belfast terribly.

questions.name: #228 Locust
questions.en:
Fancy a locust for lunch?
Probably not, if you live in the west, but elsewhere it is a different story.
Edible insects, termites, stick insects, dragonflies, grasshoppers and giant water bugs, are on the menu for an estimated 80 percent of the world' s population.
More than 1000 species of insects are served up around the world.
For example, Kungu cakes, made from midges, are a ______ in parts of Africa.
Mexico is an insect-eating, or entomophagous - hotspot, where more than 200 insect species are consumed.
  ______ is so high that 40 species are now under threat, including white agave worms.
These caterpillars of the tequila giant-skipper butterfly ______ around $250 a kilogram.
Eating insects make nutritional sense.
Some contain more protein than meat or fish.
The female gypsy moth, for instance, is about 80 percent protein.
Insects can be a good ______ of vitamins and minerals too: a type of caterpillar (Usta Terpsichore) eaten in Angola is rich in iron, zinc, and thiamine.
What do they taste like?
Ants have a lemon tang, apparently, whereas giant water bugs taste of mint and fire ant pupae of watermelon.
You have probably, inadvertently, already tasted some of these things, as insects are often accidental tourists in other types of food.
The US Food and Drug Administration even issues guidelines for the number of insect parts allowed in certain foods.
For example, it is acceptable for 225 grams of macaroni to contain up to 225 insect fragments.

questions.en:

It involves going beyond the ______ or beyond 'easy' to seek new understanding and rare ______ .
It involves looking at common issues with uncommon eyes, known problems with new skepticism, everyday conflicts with probing ______ and daily challenges with greater attention to detail.
curiosity , solutions , oblivious , caution , functions , angles , consequences , obvious
questions.full:

2. obvious
3. solutions

sense_groups.chinese: 它涉及超越显而易见或超越‘容易’

sense_groups.chinese: 以寻求新的理解和罕见的解决方案。

questions.full:

questions.name: #319 Food Prices
questions.en:
For two decades, leading up to the millennium, global demand for food increased steadily, along with growth in the world' s population, record harvests, improvements in incomes, and the diversification of diets.
As a result, food prices continued to ______ through 2000.
But beginning in 2004, prices for most grains began to rise.
Rising production could not keep pace with the even ______ growth in demand.
deteriorations , improvements , stronger , increased , decline , fluctuate , dipped
questions.full:
For two decades, leading up to the millennium, global demand for food increased steadily, along with growth in the world' s population, record harvests, improvements in incomes, and the diversification of diets.
As a result, food prices continued to ______ through 2000.
But beginning in 2004, prices for most grains began to rise.
Rising production could not keep pace with the even ______ growth in demand.

deteriorations , improvements , stronger , increased , decline , fluctuate , dipped

答案:
1. decline
2. stronger

sense_groups.english: For two decades, leading up to the millennium,
sense_groups.chinese: 在千禧年之前的二十年里，

sense_groups.english: global demand for food increased steadily,
sense_groups.chinese: 全球粮食需求稳步增长，

sense_groups.english: along with growth in the world's population, record harvests,
sense_groups.chinese: 伴随着世界人口的增长、创纪录的收成、

sense_groups.english: improvements in incomes, and the diversification of diets.
sense_groups.chinese: 收入的提高以及饮食的多样化。

sense_groups.english: As a result, food prices continued to decline through 2000.
sense_groups.chinese: 因此，食品价格在2000年之前持续下降。

sense_groups.english: But beginning in 2004,
sense_groups.chinese: 但从2004年开始，

sense_groups.english: prices for most grains began to rise.
sense_groups.chinese: 大多数谷物的价格开始上涨。

sense_groups.english: Rising production could not keep pace with the even stronger growth in demand.
sense_groups.chinese: 产量的增长无法跟上更强劲的需求增长。

questions.name: #320 Conflict
questions.en:
Most of us are ______ of open conflict and avoid it if we can.
And there is a ______ of expressing and working through conflict.
If the working through involves harsh words and name-calling, people feel deeply hurt and relationships can be ______ .
Sometimes permanently.
Some group members may be afraid that if they really ______ their anger, they may go out of control and become violent, or they may do this.

routine , rein , damaged , culminated , scared , real , reminiscent , express , risk , opaque
questions.full:
Most of us are ______ of open conflict and avoid it if we can.
And there is a ______ of expressing and working through conflict.
If the working through involves harsh words and name-calling, people feel deeply hurt and relationships can be ______ .
Sometimes permanently.
Some group members may be afraid that if they really ______ their anger, they may go out of control and become violent, or they may do this.
These fears can be very ______ and based on experience.

routine , rein , damaged , culminated , scared , real , reminiscent , express , risk , opaque

答案:
1. scared
2. risk
3. damaged
4. express
5. real

sense_groups.english: Most of us are scared of open conflict
sense_groups.chinese: 我们大多数人都害怕公开冲突

sense_groups.english: and avoid it if we can.
sense_groups.chinese: 并且尽可能避免它。

sense_groups.english: And there is a risk of expressing
sense_groups.chinese: 而且表达和解决冲突是有风险的

sense_groups.english: and working through conflict.
If the working through involves harsh words and name-calling,
sense_groups.chinese: 如果解决过程涉及严厉的言辞和辱骂，

sense_groups.english: people feel deeply hurt
sense_groups.chinese: 人们会感到深受伤害

sense_groups.english: and relationships can be damaged.
sense_groups.chinese: 关系可能会被破坏。

sense_groups.english: Sometimes permanently.
sense_groups.chinese: 有时是永久性的。

sense_groups.english: Some group members may be afraid
sense_groups.chinese: 一些团体成员可能害怕

sense_groups.english: that if they really express their anger,
sense_groups.chinese: 如果他们真的表达愤怒，

sense_groups.english: they may go out of control and become violent,
sense_groups.chinese: 他们可能会失控并变得暴力，

sense_groups.english: or they may do this.
sense_groups.chinese: 或者他们可能会这样做。

sense_groups.english: These fears can be very real
sense_groups.chinese: 这些恐惧可能非常真实

sense_groups.english: and based on experience.
sense_groups.chinese: 并且基于经验。
